  Key Responsibilities  
 
 
 Build and maintain production-grade automation using Ansible Terraform and Go

 Design implement and improve container runtime integrations (containerd runc OCI) 
 
 
 Architect CI/CD improvements and deployment pipelines for large-scale systems 
 
 
 Troubleshoot complex issues across networking load balancing containers and distributed systems 
 
 
 Harden platform infrastructure through security best practices including vulnerability scanning container image signing admission controllers and secrets management 
 
 
 Contribute directly to Vultr's open-source ecosystem (terraform provider crossplane vultr-cli govultr) 
 
 
 Improve overall reliability observability and operability of cloud-native services 
 
 
 Collaborate with product platform and infrastructure teams on feature delivery 
 
 
  Qualifications  
 
 
 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure 
 
 
 Strong experience with Kubernetes administration and internals including scheduler kubelet and CRDs 
 
 
 Proficiency in Go and scripting languages (Python Bash) for automation and tooling 
 
 
 Deep knowledge of container security including image scanning runtime isolation and admission control 
 
 
 Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform Ansible) and CI/CD pipeline design 
 
 
 Familiarity with observability stack (Prometheus Grafana alerting) and incident response practices 
 
 
 Excellent problem-solving skills across networking load balancing and distributed systems

 $125,000 - $135,000

At  ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.  This Position reports to: Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) Business Process Owner We are seeking an experienced Integration Architect with a strong foundation in  full-stack development, specializing in .NET backend technologies and Microsoft Azure . The ideal candidate will design scalable and secure solutions while providing technical leadership and aligning architectural strategy with business goals. Guides cross-functional teams through architectural decisions, ensuring technical excellence and innovation.  The preferred Working Model: Hybrid / Remote.  You will be mainly accountable for:  
 
 Solution Architecture:  Design practical, scalable, and secure solutions using .NET and Microsoft Azure that meet business and product needs. 
 
 Integration & APIs:  Design and guide integrations between applications, APIs, internal systems, and external solutions to ensure smooth and reliable connectivity. 
 
 Technical Guidance:  Provide technical guidance to development teams across .NET, front-end, database, and cloud technologies, helping teams make sound technical decisions. 
 
 Azure Solutions:  Design and improve Azure-based solutions with a focus on performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness. 
 
 DevOps & Engineering Practices:  Support good engineering practices including CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure as code, coding standards, and technical documentation. 
 
 Architecture & Security Standards:  Ensure solutions follow relevant architecture, security, data privacy, and development standards while keeping governance practical and effective. 
 
 Cross-Team Collaboration:  Work closely with internal teams and external partners to manage technical dependencies, address challenges, and support successful delivery. 
 
 Stakeholder Partnership:  Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, UX, and engineering teams to turn business requirements into effective technical solutions and support the long-term product vision. 
  Qualifications for the role:  
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 Around 7+ years of relevant experience in software development, solution architecture, integration architecture, or technical leadership within enterprise environments. 
 Strong experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft Azure, and designing modern, scalable applications and APIs. 
 Good understanding of system integrations, microservices, event-driven architecture, databases, and modern front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js. 
 Familiarity with DevOps and cloud engineering practices, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and infrastructure as code; experience modernizing existing or legacy applications is an advantage. 
 Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, development teams, business stakeholders, and external partners in a global environment. 
 Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ / CLM are preferred. 
  You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply. If you have .NET and Azure experience and enjoy designing solutions and collaborating across teams, we encourage you to apply.  Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.   Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.  Recruitment Fraud Warning   ABB  never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.  View current job openings and apply

jobs.description:
Join Our Team  
 Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team. 
 As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact. 
 We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence. 

 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced  Senior Kafka/AWS Integration Engineer  to join a project focused on building and productionizing an  event-driven middleware platform using Apache Kafka and AWS . 
 This is a highly hands-on engineering role where you will build the AWS side of the integration platform, with  Salesforce serving as the initial event source . You will work alongside the Lead Integration Architect and within the Agile sprint process, implementing solutions based on an established architecture and prioritized backlog. 
 You will work across  Apache Kafka, Amazon MSK, Java, Kafka Connect, Change Data Capture (CDC), AWS serverless technologies, and Infrastructure as Code , while helping establish reliable, testable, and maintainable event-driven integrations. 
 Responsibilities: 
 
 Provision and configure  Amazon MSK clusters, Kafka topics, and schema registry . 
 Configure and maintain  Kafka Connect and CDC source connectors . 
 Build REST-based event ingress using  Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda  to receive Salesforce events and publish them to Kafka. 
 Develop  Java stream-processing applications  to transform data between Kafka topics. 
 Build Java-based integration pipelines to deliver events from outbound topics to downstream systems. 
 Implement  dead letter queues and error-handling patterns  for reliable event processing. 
 Develop and maintain  CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and code coverage . 
 Build and maintain infrastructure using  AWS CloudFormation , enabling the client's operations team to redeploy and manage the environment. 
 Work within the client's Agile/sprint process and collaborate closely with the Lead Integration Architect. 
 Create clear technical documentation and provide ongoing  knowledge transfer  to the client's engineering and operations teams. 
 
 Requirements: 
 
  5+ years of professional software engineering experience.  
 Strong hands-on experience developing backend and integration solutions with  Java . 
 Professional experience building  event-driven and Kafka-based systems . 
 Hands-on experience working with  AWS services and cloud-based integrations . 
 Experience building and supporting production-grade integration pipelines. 
 Strong understanding of automated testing, CI/CD, and production-quality software development practices. 
 Comfortable working within an  Agile/sprint environment  under the direction of a client architect. 
 Strong communication and technical documentation skills. 
 Ability to transfer technical knowledge effectively to client engineering and operations teams. 
  Advanced written and verbal English communication skills.  
 
 Must Have: 
 
 Strong  Java  development experience, including stream processing and API components. 
 Strong hands-on experience with  Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK , including:
 
 Kafka clusters and topics 
 Kafka Connect 
 Change Data Capture (CDC) 
 Experience with  Schema Registry , including schema versioning and evolution. 
 Strong experience with  AWS serverless technologies , including:
 
 API Gateway 
 AWS Lambda 
  Infra
